scientific_integrity: The finite checker independently verifies cylinder formulas at finite scales but does not establish infinite-dimensional or invariant-measure claims; these are derived in RESULT.md. The two earlier published dynamics theorems are accepted as cited premises.
scientific_limitations: Uses published strong mixing and Lebesgue preservation of the square, plus a published inverse-cylinder formula for the first image. Does not prove uniqueness of invariant or physical measures, exactness, metric entropy, or any classification of pure singular invariant laws. The non-exact-dimensional ergodic physical mixture and its exact two local dimensions are the assessed joint claim; literature-priority uncertainty remains for equivalent general consequences.
title: An ergodic two-phase physical measure with two distinct local dimensions for an erasing interval map
